text.card: A red giant 4,194 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.93 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,890 K at its surface.
